title: Phase Transitions
equation: Transition Risk = (Closeness to Threshold + System Sensitivity) ÷ 2
hook: Markets don't change a little at a time. They sit still for years, then flip almost overnight.
statement: Systems can change suddenly and completely once a key number crosses a tipping point.
explainer: Video rental and early mobile phones didn't fade slowly. They fell off a cliff. By the time the numbers show the new world, it's already here, so watch for the tipping point early.
sop: Name the variables that could tip your market.
Watch the early warning signs every month.
Keep options open across short and long horizons.
Decide now what you'll do if a threshold is crossed.
Don't trust straight-line trends near a tipping point.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Closeness to Threshold 8, System Sensitivity 7. (8 + 7) ÷ 2 = 7.5. Higher means you're near a tipping point in a jumpy system, so expect sudden change. Lower means you've got more runway.
question: Write down one threshold in your market that, once crossed, would change everything for you.
closing_statement: By the time the data confirms it, the shift already happened.
caption:
Principle Nº 318: Phase Transitions

Markets don't change a little at a time. They sit still for years, then flip almost overnight.

Systems can change suddenly and completely once a key number crosses a tipping point.

Your turn: Write down one threshold in your market that, once crossed, would change everything for you.
